news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin at $63,600 as rare US-Japan yen action tests carry-trade fears
news.summary: Japan may have spent as much as $36.6 billion buying yen in the first joint US-Japan action to support the currency since 1998. Bitget Wallet’s Alvin Kan says it can slow a disorderly slide without reversing the broader trend.

news.title: Bhutan's GMC puts part of its bitcoin treasury to work after 10,000 BTC pledge
news.summary: The planned Gelephu Mindfulness City says 3iQ will run part of its bitcoin treasury on a market-neutral basis, a shift from holding the coins as a long-term national asset.

news.title: Why Jim Cramer’s quantum panic isn’t rattling bitcoin as price holds steady around $64,000
news.summary: Jim Cramer says he's dumping his bitcoin over quantum computing fears, but his track record of crypto and bank calls has buoyed the crypto community.

news.title: XRP holders can now borrow RLUSD on Ethereum through $280 million lending pool
news.summary: XRP holders can now borrow RLUSD against their coins on Ethereum without selling, through a $280 million vault that had never accepted an XRP-linked asset before.

news.title: A new Solana proposal aims to ramp up daily SOL Burns from $47,000 to $650,000
news.summary: SGP-0003 bundles a fee overhaul with a doubling of the disinflation rate. It needs 40 million more SOL of validator support in two weeks to reach a vote.

news.title: Bitcoin nears $64,000 as traders look past Strategy's BTC sales and Coldcard sweeps
news.summary: Every major token except ether is green on the week, with BTC up 1.9% over 24 hours and Asian equities selling off on AI-trade jitters.

news.title: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved $31 million, and it's not the only one
news.summary: A 12-year-old bitcoin wallet moved $31 million on Monday, part of a broader wave of dormant coins shifting since the Coldcard hack.

news.title: U.S. FBI intelligence agent arrested in connection with theft of $1 million in crypto
news.summary: The agent, who had "top secret" clearance and worked in FBI headquarters, was accused of taking crypto from wallets the agency had investigated.

news.title: Energy shock delivers 144% boost in profits for BP
news.summary: The British oil giant reported net profit of $5.7 billion in the second quarter, surpassing Wall Street consensus.

news.title: Meg Ryan finds a buyer for picturesque $15.25 million Hamptons property
news.summary: Actress Meg Ryan will have fewer sleepless nights after securing a buyer for her opulent Hamptons estate—just a few weeks after she listed the property for $15.25 million.
